subject: Geozone TTL proof & sampling plan for SOC2/ISO audit
messages:
From: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@bluecovebank.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: BlueCove Security <security@bluecove.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: geozone TTL evidence and sampling approach for SOC2

Hi Stephanie / Sean,

BlueCove is running a SOC2 readiness review and we need to validate tenant deletion / TTL behavior for accounts hosted in the US and EU geozones. The auditor has asked for concrete proof that:

- Data subject to a configured TTL is actually removed from persistent storage within the configured window,
- The deletion is traceable (audit trail), and
- You can provide a defensible sampling plan for 25 tenants that demonstrates the deletion workflow end-to-end.

Can you provide: a retention/TTL matrix for geozone mappings, a short-sample deletion log (just a few recent events), and a proposed sampling plan (how you select tenants, timeframe, and what artifacts we will deliver)?

Timing: the auditor wants evidence by Oct 19. If we need a call to align on the exact artifacts, happy to schedule.

Thanks,
Marco
Director, IT Risk & Compliance
BlueCove Bank
[Attachment: compliance_scope_bluecove.pdf]
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@bluecovebank.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: geozone TTL evidence and sampling approach for SOC2

Hi Marco,

Thanks for the clear ask. We can deliver the items you listed. Attached is our current retention_geozone_matrix_v1.3.xlsx and a short checklist for SOC2 artifacts. High level plan below:

1) Retention matrix: shows TTL mapping by tenant geozone, data category, and configured enforcement worker. (attached)
2) Sample deletion logs: we will extract recent deletion events for N=30 candidates and redact PII before sharing. I attached a short sample deletion log excerpt for format; full sample will follow.
3) Sampling plan (proposal):
   - Candidate pool: tenants with TTLs executed in the last 90 days in US and EU geozones.
   - Selection method: stratified random sample across geozones and tenant size (small/medium/large).
   - Evidence per tenant: deletion log, KV cache eviction timestamps, S3 object deletion marker or lifecycle event, and a signed attestation from the infra owner.

Action items and timeline:
- Today: confirm the sampling size (we propose 25) and acceptable artifact list.
- Wed (Oct 13): we deliver extended sample deletion logs (redacted) and raw retention matrix.
- Mon (Oct 18): full 25-tenant packet delivered, plus an attestation PDF for each tenant.

Can you confirm 25 tenants is acceptable, and whether the auditor requires the attestation to be on BlueCove letterhead or if a Redwood-signed attestation is sufficient?

Cc'ing Rishi and Sean for details on how we'll pull logs and produce attestation statements.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Security Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: retention_geozone_matrix_v1.3.xlsx]
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: geozone TTL evidence and sampling approach for SOC2

Stephanie,

Thanks — taking this on. Quick engineering notes for the artifact pull:

- Deletion events: we'll pull lifecycle worker logs plus object-version deletion markers from S3 for the tenant IDs. Expect CSV with event_id, tenant_id, object_key, event_type, timestamp, worker_id.
- KV cache eviction: stored in the runtime telemetry index for 45 days; we'll capture eviction timestamps and related request ids.
- Audit trail: control plane audit events (who triggered, policy id) are in the audit DB and include retention policy hashes.

Planning to create a redaction pipeline: redact emails and account numbers, keep stable ids for cross-correlation. I will generate a sample file (sample_deletion_log_20261010.txt) and drop it in the shared drive link.

If the auditor wants signed attestations per tenant, we will prepare a template Redwood attestation and can co-sign if BlueCove prefers.

I'll loop back with the extraction artifacts by COB Tue.

-sean
Senior Cloud Ops, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sample_deletion_log_20261010.txt]
From: K. Reynolds <kr@ledgerassurance.com>
To: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@bluecovebank.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: geozone TTL evidence and sampling approach for SOC2

Hi all,

The proposed approach looks good. A couple of minor asks from the auditor team:

- Please make the tenant sample selection reproducible. A documented seed and selection script or a short reproducibility note will suffice.
- For the per-tenant attestation, Ledger Assurance prefers the attestation include a brief statement that the deletion artifacts were reviewed and match the TTL policy. BlueCove letterhead is preferred, but a Redwood attestation co-signed by BlueCove is acceptable.
- One small change to timeline: can we move the final deliverable to Oct 20 to allow time for a quick internal redaction review?

If you can update the sampling plan with the reproducibility note and confirm Oct 20, we will mark the request satisfied.

Thanks,
K. Reynolds
Senior Auditor, Ledger Assurance
[Attachment: auditor_requirements_v3.pdf]
